text: Chapter Treasurer Checklist Immediately Following Election: Meet with outgoing Treasurer to discuss transition Meet with chapter Faculty Advisor and President to change authorized users on bank account(s) Acquire previous paperwork – budgets, ledgers, etc. Review National Constitution and Bylaws – Treasurer Duties Review National Constitution and Bylaws – Chapter and Individual Financial obligations Within 2 Weeks of Election: Review all financial statements and records Learn ledger, budget, and tools Acquire Receipt Books Weekly Tasks: Submit Treasurer’s Report to Secretary for Chapter Meeting Minutes Attend Chapter meetings Attend events and functions of the chapter – motivating others to do so as well Collect financial obligations of members and keep record Provide receipts for all financial transactions with the chapter Keep carbon copy in records Monthly Tasks: Provide monthly bank statements for chapter record A copy should also go to the Faculty Advisor Semester – Fall Expectations: Set deadline for collection of National Dues Should be at least a week prior to the filing of the chapter report Chapter Report is due October 15 Set deadline for collection of Province Dues Set deadline for collection of Chapter Dues Work with Chapter President on filing Chapter Report and providing payment information Semester – Spring Expectations: Set deadline for collection of National Dues Should be at least a week prior to the filing of the chapter report Chapter Report is due March 15 Set deadline for collection of Province Dues Set deadline for collection of Chapter Dues Work with Chapter President on filing Chapter Report and providing payment Yearly Expectations: Propose semester/yearly budgets Collect National Dues, which are then forwarded to Lyrecrest Collect Province Dues, which are then forwarded to designated Province Officer Assist the Auditing Committee with the annual audit
